title: Prefected
description: This modpack is designed to deliver a refined Minecraft experience that remains faithful to the original vanilla style while introducing carefully selected improvements to gameplay, performance, and overall quality of life.
body:
This modpack enhances Minecraft while keeping the classic vanilla feeling. It focuses on lightweight visuals, exploration improvements, and quality‑of‑life upgrades without changing the core gameplay.

Main Features
Xaero’s Minimap & Xaero’s World Map  
Navigate the world easily, mark important locations, and explore with detailed maps.

Improved villages and world structures  
Villages become more varied and alive, and additional structures appear throughout the world to make exploration more rewarding.

Enhanced End dimension  
The End now includes new structures and improved generation, making it more interesting without losing the vanilla atmosphere.

Lightweight shaders  
Subtle visual improvements with shaders that run smoothly even on low‑end hardware.

Quality of life improvements  
Better menus, smoother animations, clearer HUD elements, and small tweaks that make the game more comfortable to play.
